limitations: A rebuilt, digest-bound runner is used; historical binary identity is not reused.
All production build inputs match the final v0.15.1 runner source; two test files differ.
This first executable frontier is partial; blocked groups are not unsupported or complete.
PID/start polling retains unproven descendant containment; do not upgrade process/resource qualification.
No relative-performance or cross-release speedup claim is authorized by these observations.

User-authorized continuous execution removes inter-command settle waits, including A24 overhead settling. These observations do not establish the original quiet-host/settled A24 publication qualification; retain their actual environment and descriptive status.

measurement.aggregation: per slice median/min/max/quartiles with denominator and explicit missing timings; no pooling across adapters or profiles
measurement.cache: fresh isolated per-invocation HOME/TMPDIR/cache; pinned distributions on local disk; OS page cache uncontrolled
measurement.certification: Candidate timing evidence, with recorded environmental scope and contention/unknown flags, until report/population/outcome/configuration and publication checks pass. A completed contended run is not an uncontended certification.
measurement.cold: one unchanged population invocation per slice; adapter-observed subprocess wall clock only
measurement.contention: Observe and retain CPU/process contention during and after execution. Background CPU activity or unavailable CPU observations cannot abort a started invocation or stop the serial queue. Mark contended/unknown observations honestly; do not certify them as uncontended.
measurement.exclusions: build, fixture materialization, version witness, normalization, validation and hashing remain outside adapter timers
measurement.host_limits: CPU/ps/load/disk observations do not prove complete IO attribution or descendant containment; no certification of these unproven dimensions
measurement.other_overhead: all other tools remain pending exact runtime/launcher restoration; no fabricated declines
measurement.overhead: three built-in fixed repeats; publish range as upper-bound estimate; never subtract
measurement.quiet: Continuation of the same experiment: inherit the parent's already-passed initial quiet gate; record new host observations without another CPU wait or CPU-driven abort. This is not a new independent quiet qualification.
measurement.significant_external_cpu: Retain the existing >=10 percent logical-capacity observation flag and heavy-process detection as descriptive metadata after launch; neither is a post-start acceptance or termination gate.
measurement.warm: Joern and Semgrep Java only, built-in 1,2,4,8,16 prefix batches and two repeats; blocked until exact runtime closures are restored
